summary: TFS Financial Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its mutual holding company (MHC), owning 81% of the company's stock, will hold a special meeting on July 7, 2026, for members to vote on waiving the MHC's right to receive quarterly dividends totaling up to $1.27 per share over 12 months. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing under Federal Reserve Regulation MM, which requires annual member approval for such dividend waivers. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The dividend waiver is part of normal operations for mutual holding companies to allow minority shareholders to receive dividends.
